purpose: Teach: キルト/デッサン/ライフワーク/レインボー/ハヤカワ/ローソン/ベースボール/グリーンピース

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家、キルトの毛布あったな
lines.en: You had that quilted blanket at your place, didn't you?
lines.style: Playful accusation — almost teasing. Direct eye contact. Leans forward slightly, watching for his reaction. Testing him with something small and harmless.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、美術でデッサンの宿題ハマってたな、桜
lines.en: You were the one obsessing over sketches for art class, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry deflection — light, almost sing-song. Turns the mirror back on her without heat. A small smile in the voice, nothing defensive.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、研究をライフワークにしたいって言ってたな
lines.en: You said you wanted to make research your life's work, didn't you?
lines.style: Pressing gently. Still teasing but with less distance now — there's a thread of real curiosity underneath. Slower pace, slight tilt toward genuine.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、レインボーシャーベット食ってたな、桜
lines.en: You were always buying those rainbow sherbets from the convenience store, Sakura.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact observation delivered with affection. Quiet amusement. He's building a case but not mean about it — the tone is almost fond.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ハヤカワ文庫のSF漁ってたな
lines.en: You were always hunting through the Hayakawa SF shelves, weren't you?
lines.style: Lighter again. Quick pace, almost laughing at his own pile of evidence. The rhythm becomes a game — he's enjoying this.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ローソンの新作スイーツ好きだったな、桜
lines.en: You were crazy about those new desserts they released at Lawson, Sakura.
lines.style: Stacking evidence now — confident, picking up speed. Warm underneath the mock-accusatory tone. He knows her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ベースボール部だったな
lines.en: You were on the baseball team, weren't you?
lines.style: Steady, almost triumphant. The final piece. Not rushed — he's letting the weight of it land. Soft and sure.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、グリーンピース嫌いだったな、桜
lines.style: Closer now — the teasing becomes almost intimate. Quiet, warm laugh underneath. This last one is small, everyday, the most tender detail of all.
